notes: §2002:13.16.15.2 SR5: a CONTROL operand shall not have a variable-occurrence (OCCURS DEPENDING) entry subordinate to it. At --std 2002 the compiler refuses it (COBOL1699) for an operand in an output-CD record (g2-control-cd-record-odo, where §2002:A.1.2.2 SR9 sets no record size) and in working-storage (pb177).
